# .github

Shared configuration for the Zuhura-Mars GitHub organisation.

| Path | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` | Bug report and dataset request templates |
| `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | Pull request checklist |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | CI workflow shared by the repositories |
| `profile/README.md` | Organisation profile shown on GitHub |
